purpose.summary: This is a batch/interactive COBOL program that handles hospital admission (入院) data entry for the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt (billing) software system. It manages patient admission records, insurance combinations, medical procedure input, and related validations for Japanese medical billing. The program is part of the 'ORCGK02NYU' component dealing with inpatient admission entry.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance)

verdict.notes: The file is part of the well-known open-source ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) project for Japanese medical billing. Japanese comments are stored in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding but were decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled multi-byte characters in the comment display. The program is clearly production-grade with a long revision history (2002–2014). No COPY statements resolved in the truncated view but COPY directives are present (copy_count reported as 0 by mechanical scan, possibly because the COPY keyword appears inside FD/WS sections and was not counted, or copybooks are inlined). The 'copy_count: 0' mechanical indicator appears to be an undercount given visible COPY statements in the source.
